FAIL_TO_PASS: only-include-destructured-parameter-props: only includes destructured parameter props
object: correctly handles Symbol.toStringTag defined on objects
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
warn-unresolvable-assertions: warns for dynamic import attributes that cannot be resolved
catch-block-scope: uses correct scope in catch blocks
object-literal-property-overwrites: detect side-effects in overwritten properties of object literals
shadowed-setters: handles setters shadowed by computed setters
early-access-getter-value: handles accessing the value of a getter before it has been bound
track-reassigned-object-expression-return-reassignments: tracks reassignments of return expressions of members of reassigned object expressions
computed-properties: Resolve template literals in computed property keys
deoptimize-object-expressions: track deoptimizations of computed properties
early-access-getter-return: handles accessing the return expression of a getter before it has been bound
array-expression: Tree-shake known array prototype functions
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
no-default-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments by default
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
deoptimize-class: handles deoptimization of static class properties
using-statement-symbol-usage: preserves Symbol.dispose side effects when used in using statement
computed-properties: computed property keys include declarations of referenced identifiers
preserve-unknown-wellknown: always preserves well-known properties from objects if Rollup does not know about them
